children.title: The Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Ephesians
Title
children.text: The Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Ephesians.

children.title: Verse 1
children.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus.

children.title: Verse 2
children.text: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

children.title: Verse 3
children.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ,

children.title: Verse 4
children.text: according as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love.

children.title: Verse 5
children.text: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

children.title: Verse 6
children.text: to the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the Beloved.

children.title: Verse 7
children.text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace,

children.title: Verse 8
children.text: wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

children.title: Verse 9
children.text: having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure, which he hath purposed in himself.

children.title: Verse 10
children.text: That in the dispensation of the fullness of times, he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth, even in him.

children.title: Verse 11
children.text: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated, according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will,

children.title: Verse 12
children.text: that we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

children.title: Verse 13
children.text: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation.

children.title: Verse 14
children.text: In whom also, after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that Holy Spirit of promise, which is the earnest of our inheritance, until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

children.title: Verse 15
children.text: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

children.title: Verse 16
children.text: cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

children.title: Verse 17
children.text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him.

children.title: Verse 18
children.text: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened, that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

children.title: Verse 19
children.text: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power to usward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

children.title: Verse 20
children.text: which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

children.title: Verse 21
children.text: far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come.

children.title: Verse 22
children.text: And hath put all things unto his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

children.title: Verse 23
children.text: which is his body, the fullness of him that filleth all in all.

children.title: Verse 1
children.text: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins,

children.title: Verse 2
children.text: wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience,

children.title: Verse 3
children.text: among whom also we all had our conversation, in times past, in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

children.title: Verse 4
children.text: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

children.title: Verse 5
children.text: even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, by grace ye are saved,

children.title: Verse 6
children.text: and hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

children.title: Verse 7
children.text: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

children.title: Verse 8
children.text: For by grace are ye saved through faith, and that not of yourselves, it is the gift of God,

children.title: Verse 9
children.text: not of works, lest any man should boast.

children.title: Verse 10
children.text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

children.title: Verse 11
children.text: Wherefore remember that ye, being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called uncircumcision by that which is called the circumcision in the flesh made by hands,

children.title: Verse 12
children.text: that at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world.

children.title: Verse 13
children.text: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

children.title: Verse 14
children.text: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us,

children.title: Verse 15
children.text: having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances.

children.title: Verse 16
children.text: For to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace.

children.title: Verse 17
children.text: And that he might both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby.

children.title: Verse 18
children.text: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

children.title: Verse 19
children.text: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

children.title: Verse 20
children.text: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellow-citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

children.title: Verse 21
children.text: and are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief cornerstone,

children.title: Verse 22
children.text: in whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord,

children.title: Verse 23
children.text: in whom ye also are builded together for inhabitation of God through the Spirit.

children.title: Verse 1
children.text: For this cause I, Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

children.title: Verse 2
children.text: if ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to youward,

children.title: Verse 3
children.text: how that by revelation He made known unto me the mystery, as I wrote afore in few words,

children.title: Verse 4
children.text: whereby when ye read ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ,

children.title: Verse 5
children.text: which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto His holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit,

children.title: Verse 6
children.text: that the Gentiles should be fellow-heirs, and of the same body, and partakers of His promise in Christ by the gospel.

children.title: Verse 7
children.text: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of His power.

children.title: Verse 8
children.text: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

children.title: Verse 9
children.text: and to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ.

children.title: Verse 10
children.text: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

children.title: Verse 11
children.text: according to the eternal purpose which He purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord,

children.title: Verse 12
children.text: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of Him.

children.title: Verse 13
children.text: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

children.title: Verse 14
children.text: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

children.title: Verse 15
children.text: of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

children.title: Verse 16
children.text: that He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with might by His Spirit in the inner man,

children.title: Verse 17
children.text: that Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith, that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

children.title: Verse 18
children.text: may be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height,

children.title: Verse 19
children.text: and to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fullness of God.

children.title: Verse 20
children.text: Now unto Him that is able to do exceed abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

children.title: Verse 21
children.text: unto Him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus, throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

children.title: Verse 1
children.text: I therefore the prisoner of the Lord beseech you, that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

children.title: Verse 2
children.text: with all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love,

children.title: Verse 3
children.text: endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

children.title: Verse 4
children.text: There is one Body and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling,

children.title: Verse 5
children.text: one Lord, one Faith, one Baptism,

children.title: Verse 6
children.text: one God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

children.title: Verse 7
children.text: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

children.title: Verse 8
children.text: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

children.title: Verse 9
children.text: Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

children.title: Verse 10
children.text: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.

children.title: Verse 11
children.text: And he gave some apostles, and some prophets, and some evangelists, and some pastors and teachers,

children.title: Verse 12
children.text: for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ,

children.title: Verse 13
children.text: till we all come in the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ.

children.title: Verse 14
children.text: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the slight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive.

children.title: Verse 15
children.text: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ,

children.title: Verse 16
children.text: from whom the whole body fitly joined together, and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

children.title: Verse 17
children.text: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

children.title: Verse 18
children.text: having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart,

children.title: Verse 19
children.text: who, being past feeling, have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

children.title: Verse 20
children.text: But ye have not so learned Christ,

children.title: Verse 21
children.text: if so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus.

children.title: Verse 22
children.text: That ye put off, concerning the former conversation, the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts,

children.title: Verse 23
children.text: and be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

children.title: Verse 24
children.text: and that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

children.title: Verse 25
children.text: Wherefore, putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour, for we are members one of another.

children.title: Verse 26
children.text: Be ye angry, and sin not, let not the sun go down upon your wrath,

children.title: Verse 27
children.text: neither give place to the devil.

children.title: Verse 28
children.text: Let him that stole, steal no more, but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

children.title: Verse 29
children.text: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

children.title: Verse 30
children.text: And grieve not the Holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

children.title: Verse 31
children.text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice.

children.title: Verse 32
children.text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

children.title: Verse 1
children.text: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

children.title: Verse 2
children.text: and walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling savour.

children.title: Verse 3
children.text: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

children.title: Verse 4
children.text: neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient, but rather giving of thanks.

children.title: Verse 5
children.text: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

children.title: Verse 6
children.text: Let no man deceive you with vain words, for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

children.title: Verse 7
children.text: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

children.title: Verse 8
children.text: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord.

children.title: Verse 9
children.text: Walk as children of light.

children.title: Verse 10
children.text: For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness, and righteousness, and truth,

children.title: Verse 11
children.text: proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

children.title: Verse 12
children.text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

children.title: Verse 13
children.text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

children.title: Verse 14
children.text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light,

children.title: Verse 15
children.text: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

children.title: Verse 16
children.text: Wherefore he saith, Awake, thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

children.title: Verse 17
children.text: See then, that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise, redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

children.title: Verse 18
children.text: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

children.title: Verse 19
children.text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess, but be filled with the Spirit;

children.title: Verse 20
children.text: speaking to yourselves in psalms, and hymns, and spiritual songs,

children.title: Verse 21
children.text: singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

children.title: Verse 22
children.text: giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

children.title: Verse 23
children.text: submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

children.title: Verse 24
children.text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

children.title: Verse 25
children.text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church, and He is the Saviour of the body.

children.title: Verse 26
children.text: Therefore, as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in everything.

children.title: Verse 27
children.text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave Himself for it,

children.title: Verse 28
children.text: that He might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

children.title: Verse 29
children.text: that He might present it to Himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing, but that it should be holy, and without blemish.

children.title: Verse 30
children.text: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies.

children.title: Verse 31
children.text: He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

children.title: Verse 32
children.text: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh, but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church.

children.title: Verse 33
children.text: For we are members of His body, of His flesh, and of His bones.

children.title: Verse 34
children.text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they too shall be one flesh.

children.title: Verse 35
children.text: This is a great mystery.

children.title: Verse 36
children.text: But I speak concerning Christ and the church.

children.title: Verse 37
children.text:
Template:Text
        Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself, and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

children.title: Verse 1
children.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

children.title: Verse 2
children.text: Honour thy father and mother, which is the first commandment with promise,

children.title: Verse 3
children.text: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

children.title: Verse 4
children.text: And ye, fathers, provoke not your children to wrath, but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

children.title: Verse 5
children.text: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

children.title: Verse 6
children.text: not with eye service, as men pleases, but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

children.title: Verse 7
children.text: with good will doing service as to the Lord, and not to men;

children.title: Verse 8
children.text: knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

children.title: Verse 9
children.text: And ye, masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening, knowing that your master also is in heaven, neither is their respective persons with him.

children.title: Verse 10
children.text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of His might.

children.title: Verse 11
children.text: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

children.title: Verse 12
children.text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

children.title: Verse 13
children.text: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

children.title: Verse 14
children.text: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness,

children.title: Verse 15
children.text: and your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace.

children.title: Verse 16
children.text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

children.title: Verse 17
children.text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,

children.title: Verse 18
children.text: praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

children.title: Verse 19
children.text: and for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel,

children.title: Verse 20
children.text: for which I am an ambassador in bonds, that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

children.title: Verse 21
children.text: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things,

children.title: Verse 22
children.text: whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that ye might comfort your hearts.

children.title: Verse 23
children.text: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

children.title: Verse 24
children.text: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

children.title: Epilogue
children.text: The end of the epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Ephesians.
